# Coherent DP-PAM4 Optical Communication System with JAX High-Speed ​​LMS Equalization
Welcome to the interactive simulation experiment of optical communication using pure one-dimensional real modulation (PAM4)! This tutorial demonstrates how to use the data-driven + hard-decision hybrid (DA/DD-LMS) algorithm.

🎛️ 交互式物理损伤控制台 (PAM4 JAX 极速版)
